# Travis Murdock

> Storyteller and Builder. Head of GTM at CopilotKit. Personal site and contact point.

This is a single-page personal site. The canonical (and currently only) page is the homepage.

## About

Travis Murdock is the Head of Go-To-Market at [CopilotKit](https://copilotkit.ai), the open-source framework for in-app AI copilots and agents. He is also a lead mentor in the Techstars Seattle program. Based in the Greater Seattle Area.

## Site contents

- [Homepage](https://travismurdock.com/): Logo and contact email.

## Identity

Structured `Person` data is embedded as JSON-LD in the homepage `<head>` for machine-readable identity.
